title: Noise sensitivity and noise stability
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $0\le\delta\le1$, and let $f$ map the $n$-dimensional sign cube to signs. Its noise sensitivity at rate $\delta$ equals one half of one minus the noise stability of its real-valued version at correlation $1-2\delta$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional sign cube to signs
